description: Abstract base class for SQL entities in the Thingsboard project, providing common fields and utility methods for entity management.

classes.name: BaseSqlEntity
classes.description: Abstract generic class representing a SQL entity with UUID and creation time, including utility methods for ID and JSON handling.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Returns the UUID of the entity.

methods.name: setUuid
methods.description: Sets the UUID of the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedTime
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp if positive.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Converts UUID to entity ID using provided creator function.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Converts JsonNode to specified class type.

methods.name: listFromString
methods.description: Parses comma-separated string into list with mapping function.
